opportunities.opportunity_id: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review. In special cases, and by prior agreement, we accept applications for up to £750,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must be relevant to at least one of the priority questions, have a clear impact path, conceptual framework, appropriate methodology, experienced team, and offer good value for money. Individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the five interconnected priorities and aim to improve lives in the UK.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from diverse backgrounds, particularly from racially minoritised communities, are encouraged to apply. Partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society.
